tip.en: Grade explodes from 15% to 34% here as you enter the steepest shelf of Kenneth Park — HR is only 125 but will spike 9 beats in the next 30 seconds. With 111m of gain in just 4.3km today versus an average of 18m across recent runs, this is where the day's real work begins.
tip.zh: 此处坡度从15%骤升至34%，进入肯尼斯公园最陡的台地。心率目前仅125，但接下来30秒将急涨9下。与近期跑步平均仅18米的爬升相比，今天111米的爬升在这里正式开始。

title.zh: 爬坡中段心率越过均值线

tip.en: At 137m altitude and HR 141 — right at your run's average — pace is still a steady 17:22 on 8% grade. The next 40 seconds will push you to your session ceiling of 160 bpm; notice how the approach is controlled here before the terrain kicks up again.
tip.zh: 海拔137米，心率141正好等于本次平均值，配速在8%坡度上仍保持稳定的17:22。接下来40秒将把你推向本次最高心率160；在地形再度陡峭之前，这里的节奏控制值得注意。

title.en: Cardiac Ceiling on the Descent Roll-Out

tip.en: HR peaks at 160 here — your max for the session and 6 bpm above anything you hit in the last month of flat running. Interestingly this happens not at the steepest climb but during the rollover onto an 8-9% slope after the descent, suggesting cardiovascular lag from the brutal 50% pitch two minutes earlier.
tip.zh: 心率在此触达160峰值，是本次最高值，也比上个月所有平路跑高出6次。有趣的是，这并非发生在最陡处，而是在急坡之后的8-9%缓坡上，说明两分钟前50%坡度带来的心血管滞后仍在持续。

title.en: Planned Pause at the Ridge Flat

tip.en: Pace vanishes and HR begins dropping from 148 toward 130 over the next 25 seconds — a deliberate stop at 145.6m, the highest sustained flat of the route. It's a smart choice: you've just climbed 52m in 0.3km, and resetting before the second half protects quality on the back loops.
tip.zh: 配速消失，心率从148开始在25秒内降至130——在海拔145.6米、全程最高平台处主动停止。这是明智之举：你刚在0.3公里内爬升52米，在后半段开始前重置状态，有助于保证后程质量。

tip.en: Two seconds after the stop, pace drops to 2:40/km — the fastest reading in the run by far. This looks like a GPS snap after the standstill rather than an intentional burst, but HR stays flat at 130, confirming the body was still in recovery. Don't let GPS flattery inflate your perception of this effort.
tip.zh: 停止后两秒，配速骤降至2:40/公里——全程最快读数。这看起来更像静止后的GPS漂移，而非刻意冲刺，心率稳定在130也印证身体仍在恢复中。不要让GPS的虚高数据误导你对这段努力的判断。

tip.en: HR jumps from 143 to 150 in just six seconds as grade steepens through 8-9% — this is the second major climb of the day kicking in after 700m of recovery. You're carrying more fatigue than the first ascent; notice the pace is 8:25 vs ~8:00 on comparable grade earlier.
tip.zh: 心率在短短六秒内从143跳升至150，坡度陡增至8-9%——这是经历700米恢复段后第二次主要爬坡的开始。与第一次爬坡相比你带着更多疲劳，同等坡度下配速8:25慢于早些时候的约8:00。

title.en: High Point — Carry It Down Clean

tip.en: 153.6m, HR 153, pace 6:34 on nearly flat ground — you've crested the second climb and HR is well-managed. The next 1.4km drops 80m; your challenge is to let gravity help without letting HR spike on the steeper pitches that arrive around 2.8km.
tip.zh: 海拔153.6米，心率153，近平地配速6:34——你已越过第二次爬坡的顶点，心率控制良好。接下来1.4公里下降80米，挑战在于借助重力的同时，避免在约2.8公里处更陡的下坡段心率飙升。

tip.en: Grade hits -17.7% and will touch -20% in the next few steps — the most aggressive descent of the run. HR has already dropped to 137 and continues falling, which is positive, but watch quad load: at ~8:58 pace you're braking hard. With six previous flat runs averaging 18m of gain, your legs may not be conditioned for this eccentric stress.
tip.zh: 坡度达到-17.7%并将在几步内触及-20%，是全程最陡的下坡。心率已降至137并持续下降，这是好信号，但需注意股四头肌负荷：以约8:58的配速你在大力制动。考虑到之前六次平路跑平均爬升仅18米，双腿可能还未适应这种离心应力。

title.en: Final Climb — Honest Effort to the Close
title.zh: 最后爬坡——诚实地跑到终点

tip.en: HR re-accelerates from 141 to 154 over the next 90 seconds on 4-6% grade, nearly matching the second climb's ceiling. After 4km and 100m of gain, maintaining 6:08-7:00 pace here shows real aerobic durability — this is the most revealing segment of the run for fitness assessment.
tip.zh: 心率在接下来90秒内从141重新升至154，坡度4-6%，几乎与第二段爬坡的峰值齐平。在经历4公里和100米爬升后，仍能维持6:08至7:00的配速，体现出真实的有氧耐力——这是本次跑步中最能反映体能水平的一段。
